notes: 1.5.5 / HA0.6.20：显式点击更新或写值时，在连接前清除本设备在ESPHome代理的旧主机服务表，避免普通模式和OTA模式切换时因缓存失配浪费一轮广播；保留能力读取和异常缓存重试。此优化位于HA，固件仅更新版本号。计量、光照、采样、休眠、电量及约每分钟300毫秒普通广播不变，完整镜像写入和CRC校验不变。双构建、固件故障测试和84项HA回归通过；1.5.4→1.5.5实体OTA已成功：成功轮122.8秒，等待唤醒72.745秒（4次尝试）、连接4.926秒、擦除1.125秒、上传37.480秒、完整CRC1.330秒、END0.144秒、重启确认5.003秒。HA确认1.5.5、100%、OTA关闭，燃气22.52m³保留，普通广播恢复。此前一轮180.2秒唤醒超时，未进入擦写，随后重试成功；不能把成功轮较短耗时等同为整体可靠性或提速保证。未测功耗。仅公开OTA镜像，完整烧录包仅本地。
notes_en: 1.5.5 / HA0.6.20: before an explicit update or settings connection, discard this meter’s old ESPHome host service table. This avoids wasting an advertising cycle on a normal/OTA mode cache mismatch; retain capability reads and checked cache recovery. The optimization is in HA; firmware changes only its version. Metering, optics, sampling, sleep, battery, normal 300 ms/minute advertising, complete image writes and CRC are unchanged. Matching builds, firmware fault tests and 84 HA regressions pass; Physical 1.5.4→1.5.5 OTA passed: the successful run took 122.8 s, including wake 72.745 s (4 attempts), connection 4.926 s, erase 1.125 s, upload 37.480 s, whole-image CRC 1.330 s, END 0.144 s and reboot confirmation 5.003 s. HA confirmed 1.5.5, 100%, OTA off, preserved 22.52 m³ and resumed normal advertisements. A preceding run timed out after 180.2 s during wake without erasing/programming; the retry succeeded. The shorter successful run does not establish overall reliability or a guaranteed speedup. Power was not measured. Publish OTA images only; full recovery remains local.
